data.long_meaning: Nourishing rain cloud that provides life-giving water. Parents who choose Iqlima usually hope their child will grow to embody rain cloud and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqlima total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Iqlima" is a beautiful Arabic word meaning a nourishing rain cloud that provides life-giving water, which is a powerful representation of the importance of water in desert environments. In many Islamic cultures, water is considered a crucial element for life, both literally and spiritually, and the image of a rain cloud providing sustenance is a common metaphor for blessings and divine providence.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Iqlima" holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture, as it symbolizes the concept of Allah, the all-powerful and merciful deity, providing sustenance to His creation. This name invokes the idea of a blessings-giver and nourisher, highlighting the belief in God's benevolence and care for His people. The name "Iqlima" also serves as a reminder of the power and importance of water, and the responsibility to preserve and protect this valuable resource as a gift from Allah.
